title: 12 South Carriage House - 3 miles from Downtown!
description:
Situated 2 blocks from the hottest and most walkable area of Nashville - 12 South!  Less than 3 miles to Broadway, downtown attractions, & Music City Center.  Less than 2 miles from Vanderbilt, Belmont, & Lipscomb Universities!

This charming gem is situated a short walk to the popular district of 12 South.  An easy walk to coffee shops, lively bars, boutique shopping, and amazing restaurants.  Chill out in Sevier Park with local gourmet ice cream & enjoy the farmers market & playground too!

The space
Construction on this charming space was done to mimic a 1890's Victorian space, but with modern necessities of course!  The apartment is located behind one of the most prominent historic homes in the district. Up one flight of stairs and you’ll find two private bedrooms with queen beds, a sofa that folds out to a single bed (somewhere between a twin and a full), a stylish modern farmhouse bath with walk-in shower, period antiques, vintage lighting, walnut floors and private off-street parking.  Even a private outdoor patio for a place to sit outside and enjoy a meal.  An extremely comfortable space with central heat and air conditioning, new appliances and beds you'll want to sleep in all day.  Even a tank-less gas water heater with an endless supply of hot water.

Guest access
Private access and door code will be sent out the day before arrival.
